rows.statement_text:
WITH activity AS (
  SELECT j.user_id, j.created_at AS acted_at FROM public.jobs j
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.user_id, t.created_at FROM public.tailored_cvs t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.user_id, e.created_at FROM public.exports e
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.user_id, a.started_at FROM public.ai_runs a
),
weekly_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('week', acted_at)::date AS week_start, user_id
    FROM activity
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT w.week_start,
         w.user_id,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weekly_users p
                  WHERE p.user_id = w.user_id
                    AND p.week_start = w.week_start - 7) AS is_returning
    FROM weekly_users w
)
SELECT f.week_start,
       count(*) AS active_users,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.is_returning) AS returning_users,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.is_returning) / count(*), 1) AS return_rate_pct,
       array_agg(u.full_name ORDER BY u.full_name) AS user_names
  FROM flagged f
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = f.user_id
 GROUP BY f.week_start
 ORDER BY f.week_start DESC

rows.statement_text:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AS day_start,
         date_trunc('day', now())                    AS day_end
),
activity AS (
  SELECT j.user_id, 'job_tracked' AS action, j.created_at AS acted_at, NULL::integer AS tokens
    FROM public.jobs j, bounds b
   WHERE j.created_at >= b.day_start AND j.created_at < b.day_end
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.user_id, 'cv_tailored', t.created_at, NULL::integer
    FROM public.tailored_cvs t, bounds b
   WHERE t.created_at >= b.day_start AND t.created_at < b.day_end
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.user_id, 'export', e.created_at, NULL::integer
    FROM public.exports e, bounds b
   WHERE e.created_at >= b.day_start AND e.created_at < b.day_end
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.user_id, 'ai_run', a.started_at, a.total_tokens
    FROM public.ai_runs a, bounds b
   WHERE a.started_at >= b.day_start AND a.started_at < b.day_end
)
SELECT u.id AS user_id,
       u.full_name,
       count(*) AS actions_yesterday,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE act.action = 'job_tracked') AS jobs_tracked,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE act.action = 'cv_tailored') AS cvs_tailored,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE act.action = 'export') AS exports_created,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE act.action = 'ai_run') AS ai_runs_started,
       sum(act.tokens) AS ai_tokens_yesterday,
       min(act.acted_at) AS first_action_at,
       max(act.acted_at) AS last_action_at
  FROM activity act
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = act.user_id
 GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name
 ORDER BY actions_yesterday DESC, last_action_at DESC

   WHERE e.created_at >= b.day_start AND e.created_at < b.day_end

    FROM public.ai_runs a, bounds b

)
SELECT u.id AS user_id,
       u.full_name,
       count(*) AS actions_today,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE act.action = 'job_tracked') AS jobs_tracked,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE act.action = 'cv_tailored') AS cvs_tailored,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE act.action = 'export') AS exports_created,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE act.action = 'ai_run') AS ai_runs_started,
       sum(act.tokens) AS ai_tokens_today,

       max(act.acted_at) AS last_action_at
  FROM activity act

rows.statement_text: WITH tok AS (SELECT sum(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(run_count) AS total_runs FROM reporting.v_ai_tokens_by_month), span AS (SELECT min(run_day) AS first_run_day, max(run_day) AS last_run_day, (max(run_day) - min(run_day) + 1) AS span_days, count(DISTINCT run_day) AS active_days FROM reporting.v_ai_runs_by_day) SELECT tok.total_tokens, tok.total_runs, span.first_run_day, span.last_run_day, span.span_days, span.active_days, round(tok.total_tokens::numeric / span.span_days, 1) AS avg_tokens_per_calendar_day, round(tok.total_tokens::numeric / tok.total_runs, 1) AS avg_tokens_per_run FROM tok, span

rows.statement_text: WITH spine AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', day)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS days_in_month, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE jobs_created + cvs_tailored + exports_created + ai_runs_started > 0) AS active_days, SUM(jobs_created) AS jobs_created, SUM(cvs_tailored) AS cvs_tailored, SUM(exports_created) AS exports_created, SUM(ai_runs_started) AS ai_runs_started FROM reporting.v_daily_activity GROUP BY 1), tok AS (SELECT month, SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, SUM(run_count) AS token_runs, SUM(non_completed_count) AS ai_non_completed FROM reporting.v_ai_tokens_by_month GROUP BY month), cv AS (SELECT month, SUM(tailored_cv_count) AS tailored_cvs, SUM(deleted_count) AS tailored_deleted FROM reporting.v_cv_production GROUP BY month), sub AS (SELECT month, SUM(new_subscriptions) AS new_subscriptions FROM reporting.v_subscriptions_new_by_month GROUP BY month), coh AS (SELECT signup_month, SUM(user_count) AS cohort_users, SUM(onboarded_count) AS onboarded FROM reporting.v_user_cohorts GROUP BY signup_month) SELECT s.month, s.days_in_month, s.active_days, s.jobs_created, s.cvs_tailored, s.exports_created, s.ai_runs_started, t.total_tokens, t.ai_non_completed, cv.tailored_cvs, cv.tailored_deleted, j.job_count, j.distinct_users AS job_users, j.applied_count, sub.new_subscriptions, coh.cohort_users, coh.onboarded, f.signed_up, f.created_master_cv, f.created_tailored_cv, f.exported, f.subscribed FROM spine s LEFT JOIN tok t ON t.month = s.month LEFT JOIN cv ON cv.month = s.month LEFT JOIN reporting.v_jobs_by_month j ON j.month = s.month LEFT JOIN sub ON sub.month = s.month LEFT JOIN coh ON coh.signup_month = s.month LEFT JOIN reporting.v_activation_funnel_monthly f ON f.cohort_month = s.month ORDER BY s.month

rows.statement_text: WITH ai AS (SELECT run_day, COALESCE(SUM(run_count) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'), 0) AS ai_completed, COALESCE(SUM(run_count) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed'), 0) AS ai_failed, COALESCE(SUM(run_count) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending'), 0) AS ai_pending FROM reporting.v_ai_runs_by_day GROUP BY run_day), tr AS (SELECT changed_day, SUM(transitions) AS job_transitions FROM reporting.v_job_status_transitions GROUP BY changed_day) SELECT d.day, COALESCE(s.new_users, 0) AS new_users, d.jobs_created, d.cvs_tailored, d.exports_created, d.ai_runs_started, COALESCE(ai.ai_completed, 0) AS ai_completed, COALESCE(ai.ai_failed, 0) AS ai_failed, COALESCE(ai.ai_pending, 0) AS ai_pending, COALESCE(tr.job_transitions, 0) AS job_transitions FROM reporting.v_daily_activity d LEFT JOIN reporting.v_user_signups_by_day s ON s.signup_day = d.day LEFT JOIN ai ON ai.run_day = d.day LEFT JOIN tr ON tr.changed_day = d.day ORDER BY d.day
